predeclaredDecision.candidateSelection: Prefer scoped-work with acceptAt=0.8. Choose rejectAt on development/calibration only; keep the simplest shared threshold if stage-specific policies are not justified.
gates: Final required-tool recall at least 95% on each acceptance trial
No lower final required-tool recall than baseline
No lower required-intent recall than baseline
Explicit required skills all retained and loaded
No increase in rubric-irrelevant skill selections or tool exposure against baseline
Existing permission, stale-result, visibility and execution gates continue to pass
predeclaredDecision.failurePolicy: If acceptance fails, do not retune on this set or install the candidate. Preserve failures and report no-ship. Packaged candidate acceptance is conditional on semantic acceptance.
predeclaredDecision.limitations: Agent-authored synthetic labels. These gates establish a bounded regression comparison, not population-wide reliability or independent human validation. Large MCP catalogs, attachments and real workflow task quality need separate coverage.
predeclaredDecision.selectionReason: Lower acceptance thresholds increased irrelevant selections without repairing the remaining git-diff tool miss. Raising the rejection cutoff reduced fallback-driven excess exposure on both development and calibration while preserving their required recall.

limitations: Synthetic agent-authored labels; not independently human validated.
Repeated trials share the same 20 acceptance cases; they are not 60 independent tasks.
The first development baseline summary predates the correction to include Standard taskClass when scoring intents. Use the acceptance comparison for matched current scoring.
Earlier exploratory experiments carry their original corpus hashes and labels; label revisions preceded acceptance.
Selections use production routing functions and 109 registered fixture tools; actual execution, platform frontends, setup/readiness and external MCP catalogs are not exercised.
Provider cost is a ledger estimate, not a billing reconciliation.
No production policy or installed app/gateway changes.

validation.initialEnvironmentFailures: Sandbox local-server restrictions and a borrowed workspace dependency link; isolated locked install and appropriate local-server permissions resolved them.
